item.title: The Predator Behind The Camera
item.description: Harvey Glatman lured aspiring models to fake photography sessions before abducting and murdering them during the late 1950s. Investigators ultimately connected him to a series of killings through forensic evidence and survivor testimony, bringing an end to one of California's most disturbing serial murder cases. His crimes remain a chilling example of manipulation, deception, and predatory behavior.

item.title: She Survived The Impossible: Alison Botha
item.description: In 1994, Alison Botha survived a brutal attack that left doctors astonished she was still alive. Despite life-threatening injuries, she managed to seek help and later identified her attackers, leading to their convictions. Her extraordinary resilience has made her story one of the most remarkable accounts of survival and recovery in modern criminal history.

item.title: Lucy Letby: The Worst Nurse The UK Has Ever Seen
item.description: Lucy Letby was convicted of murdering and attempting to murder infants while working in a neonatal unit in England. The investigation, one of the largest in NHS history, relied on medical evidence, hospital records, and witness testimony. The case sparked widespread debate about patient safety, hospital oversight, and the handling of concerns raised by medical staff
